correctness.rationale: On the smooth rational elliptic model, Shioda–Tate gives rank zero and the discriminant/index of the trivial lattice in the unimodular Néron–Severi lattice gives order three. The explicit nonzero flex confirms the torsion, and the height equation c(9−c)/9=2+2(P·O) forces c=3 or 6 and P·O=0; inversion gives the other component. The sections are pairwise disjoint. Nefness of the fiber and adjunction with K=−F force every negative irreducible curve to be a reducible-fiber component or a section, exhausting the graph. After taking the negative intersection form and eliminating each selected section, only marked cycle vertices have diagonal lowered to one. A proper cycle subset breaks into paths: unmarked paths and paths with one endpoint mark are positive definite; an internal mark contains the singular marked star, and two endpoint marks contain the singular arc with both sections. The full fiber is already singular. The ten sets form an antichain, so the obstructions are exactly the minimal ones. Independent exact inclusion–exclusion over their union sizes (python3 /workspace/independent_checks/chambers.py) gave coefficients 1,12,66,220,492,768,837,612,270,48 with all higher coefficients zero and sum 3326. The established chamber correspondence adds precisely one nef chamber.
residual_risks: The computation verifies the enumeration, not the geometric exhaustion, which is supplied by proof. The result concerns the specified smooth surface over C and not Mori chambers.
